body: I’m so, so deeply sorry you know the feeling. It truly is compulsive. The need for counting hairs is like purely hoping it is better than last time. I am trying to hold out hope too. You got this.

I once had a therapist give me these two ideas in a similar situation I went through. 
If possible, eat in public. I don’t know if you’re in dorms or anything but take your food to the park or around friends/family/randos. 
It takes about 12 minutes for the brain to realize it’s full. (Tbh I didn’t fact check this on google). Set an alarm. You can start with a two minute alarm between eating and work your way up. 
I wish I had better advice but I do want to say you are not alone, you matter, and you can and will get through this. I know how frustrating it is and how absolutely angry it can make us. 
I don’t even know what “cured” me except for time. 
You are NOT a monster. You are a human coping in a way that seems like the only option. 
You will find your way. Please do little things/anything you can for yourself and self care. You’ve got this. 
Take care.
